body:
Kanban priority queue, card GFD-124433, founder: "when you are a lvl 10 warrior in gfd and you
switch to RDM for the first time you go back to lvl 1 and you can level up to 5 and switch back
to your level 10 war or to the lvl 1 mnk separate lvls/job."

Root cause: p.charXP was one CharXP struct per character, shared across every job -- cmdSetJob
never touched it when switching jobs. Fixed with a minimally-invasive design: p.charXP stays a
live alias into a new p.jobXP map[string]*xp.CharXP entry for whichever job is active, so every
existing read/write of p.charXP.* stays correct with zero changes elsewhere. Two new pure,
independently-tested functions: switchActiveJob (switch to/lazily create a job's own entry) and
loadJobXP (build the initial map on connect, seeding the main job's first-ever row from the
character's legacy single level/xp columns for backward compat).

Persists via IDUNA's new character_job_levels table/API. Two real, found-live twin bugs fixed:
cmdSetJob never refreshed p.charJob.MainLvl on a plain job switch; the telnet-reconnect-by-
name-cache path never called applyJobStats after loading a returning character's level.

11 new tests. GOWORK=off go build/vet/test ./... clean across the whole module.

GoblinFoxDragon commit 217cccb. IDUNA commit 4bc9d1f.
